about_the_game:
Elemental Labyrinth is a pixel-art tower defense game where you shape the battlefield and control the flow of battle. Construct your own maze to dictate enemy paths, summon random elemental Spirits, and fuse them into stronger forms to counter relentless waves of foes.

Each Spirit wields unique abilities—combine them strategically to create powerful synergies and adapt to ever-growing threats. Experiment with different layouts, Spirit combinations to perfect your defense.

With retro-inspired pixel art, deep tactical gameplay, and endless strategic possibilities, Elemental Labyrinth offers a fresh take on the tower defense genre. Will your labyrinth stand the test of time?

🏗️Build your own maze

At the start of each wave, summon five random elemental blocks. Select one to keep, while the others become part of your maze—shaping enemy paths and dictating their approach. Plan carefully to create the perfect labyrinth!

🌪️Call Forth Spirits with Elemental Fusion

Fuse base elements in different combinations to summon powerful Spirits. Each fusion unlocks unique abilities, allowing for endless strategic possibilities. Experiment to find the strongest combinations for your defense!

🧙‍♂️Discover Unique Spirits

With over 50 unique Spirits (and more on the way), mix and match different formations to unleash devastating synergies. Master their abilities to create the ultimate defensive lineup!

🤝Collaborate with friends

Team up with other players online to build defenses faster and hold off even tougher enemy waves. But be warned—cooperation comes with a challenge, as enemies grow stronger to match your combined power!

🚀Future updates

We're constantly working on new content! Expect more game modes, Spirits, and features in future updates. Stay tuned for exciting additions to the game!

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550
